title: Romantic Getaway to Portugal: A Couple's Guide for 2026
metaDescription: Plan the perfect romantic trip to Portugal. Sunset spots, intimate dining, and unforgettable experiences for couples in love.
excerpt: Portugal sets the stage for romance like nowhere else. From sunset views to intimate dinners, this guide will help you plan the perfect couple's getaway.
author: Wanderlust Team
content:
The magic of Portugal lies in its ability to surprise you at every turn. This guide is for anyone planning a romantic getaway to Portugal who wants to experience the real heart of this incredible destination.

## Most Romantic Spots

- Sunset viewpoints that offer breathtaking panoramas over Portugal
- Secluded beaches and hidden coves perfect for private moments
- Candlelit restaurants serving the finest local cuisine
- Scenic walks through charming neighborhoods and historic streets

![Romantic Portugal](https://images.unsplash.com/photo-1555881400-69a2384edcd4?fm=webp&w=1200&q=60)

## Romantic Activities

Couples spa treatments using local ingredients offer relaxation and rejuvenation in Portugal.

## Where to Stay

Villa rentals offer privacy and space for couples who want to create their own romantic retreat in Portugal.
